deck: Nifty closed at 25,350 (▼ 1.75%) and Sensex at 82,436 (▼ 1.77%). Over the last five sessions Nifty is up 0.2%. Brent crude is near $87 a barrel and the rupee at 92.90 to the dollar.
story: Of the 80 large stocks this page tracks, 14 rose and 66 fell. POLICYBZR led the gainers (+6.48%), while TATASTEEL fell the most (-8.43%). Bank Nifty ended ▼ 3.17%.
Across markets: Brent crude near $87 a barrel (-6.8% on the week), the rupee at 92.90 per dollar (stronger on the week), gold near $3,623 an ounce.

In the headlines: “Stock Market Today: Sensex Crashes 1,484 Points, Nifty Fall…” (theopenpress.in). “Crude oil prices extend losses, drop 23% in November; Brent crude drops 3%; WTI dips below $80 per barrel” (Upstox).
One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is down 6.8% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 92.90 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
